recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current authoritative Group CodeSystem and StructureDefinition satisfy FHIR-28107, and additional narrative would be redundant with the required conformance source and existing Group boundaries text.
issue_request: FHIR-28107 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for R5 asking that Group support groups of Location and Organization resources, enabling criteria-based aggregated sets such as locations by geography or organizations by jurisdiction.
initial_application: No commit in the current history explicitly mentions FHIR-28107. The requested source state appears to have been applied by commit 272e3fb71ecb0d87630a48101b00015f0f18b038 for FHIR-24848, which added the group-type codes location and organization and added Location and Organization as Group.member.entity target profiles.
additional_context: FHIR-24848 is related background rather than a substitute for FHIR-28107 because the FHIR-28107 resolution explicitly said the FHIR-24848 List/participant-scope reasoning did not preclude groups of Organizations and Locations by criteria. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-11-16 record the persuasive FHIR-28107 vote and note that Location could be reasonable in Group and Group of Organization is the same. Later Group scope work, including FHIR-49851 and current source updates, retained Location and Organization.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists Group as an active resource, source/group/codesystem-group-type.xml defines location and organization Group.type codes, and source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml lists Location and Organization in the Group.type comment and Group.member.entity Reference targets.

related_jiras.note: Linked in the FHIR-28107 discussion and implemented the participant-scope Group source changes that added Location and Organization, but FHIR-28107 independently confirmed those types are allowed.
Later Group scope clarification retained Location and Organization while updating related Group.type guidance.
Later reconciliation restored BodyStructure in the same Group type/member surfaces, confirming Location and Organization were already present and unaffected.
